license_note: The tiiuae/Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct model card names the Falcon-LLM License and links TII's Falcon terms page, which states the licence is based on Apache License 2.0 with modifications and incorporates an Acceptable Use Policy, hosted on FalconLLM.tii.ae, that users and downstream distributors must follow. The commercial grant plus use-policy duties make the release source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct weights published in TII's Hugging Face repository under the Falcon LLM License named by the model card

access_boundary: This record represents the Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct checkpoint of the Falcon-H1 family. The base model, the 0.5B through 34B siblings, the Falcon 3 and Falcon 2 generations, the Falcon Arabic line, and the Falcon-H1R reasoning releases are separate boundaries.
strengths: Small-to-medium instruction checkpoint TII positions against larger LLaMA and Qwen offerings for on-device and resource-limited use
Commercially usable Apache-based grant with the use policy published alongside the licence text on TII's own Falcon site
tradeoffs: The incorporated acceptable-use policy and licence modifications need legal review before regulated or client-facing use
No developer API or managed host serves this checkpoint, so running it is entirely self-operated
